name: Craft Suite
summary: Portable Craft workflow prose for editing selected image, vector, slide or PDF workcopies and verifying Photo-to-Vector handoffs with explicit evidence boundaries. Drives the ArtCraft open tool family (github.com/storytold: PhotoCraft, VectorCraft, DeckCraft, PrintCraft and more). Original OpenRA work: no executable code, no application-internal recipes.

summaryI18n.zh-CN: 可移植的 Craft 工作流文本：编辑选定的图像、矢量、幻灯或 PDF 工作副本，并以明确的证据边界核对 Photo→Vector 交接。驱动 ArtCraft 开源工具族（github.com/storytold：PhotoCraft、VectorCraft、DeckCraft、PrintCraft 等）。OpenRA 原创文本：不含可执行代码与应用内部配方。

permissionsNote: This skill carries no allowed-tools declarations and no executable code; it never grants host approvals. Craft tools it mentions are upstream applications with their own authorship and licences.
